title: He Disobeyed Orders and Hand-Wrote 6,000 Visas to Save Lives
description:
Chiune Sugihara, a Japanese diplomat in Lithuania, defied direct orders from Tokyo and hand-wrote thousands of visas that saved roughly 6,000 Jewish refugees in 1940.

Did you know this actually happened? Let me know in the comments.
